content: प्रजा (Changed to प्रजस् at the end of a <ab>Bah.</ab> compound, when the first member is अ, सु or दुस्; as अवेक्षितप्रजः <ls>R. 8. 32</ls>; सुप्रजस् <ls n="R.">18. 29.</ls>) .²1 Procreation, generation, propagation, birth, production. .²2 Offspring, progeny, issue; children, brood (of animals); प्रजार्थव्रतकर्शिताङ्गम् <ls>R. 2. 73</ls>; प्रजायै गृहमेधिनाम् <ls>R. 1. 7</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 42</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 269</ls>; so बकस्य प्रजा, सर्पप्रजा <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Posterity, descendants. .²4 A creature. .²6 Subjects, people, mankind; ननन्दुः सप्रजाः प्रजाः <ls>R. 4. 3</ls>; प्रजाः प्रजाः स्वा इव तन्त्रयित्वा <ls>Ś. 5. 5</ls> and स्वाभ्यः प्रजाभ्यो हि यथा तथैव सर्वप्रजाभ्यः शिवमाशशंसे <ls>Bu. Ch. 2. 35</ls> (where प्रजा has sense 2 also); <ls>R. 1. 7</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 73</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 8</ls>. .²6 Semen. .²7 An era; <ls>Buddh.</ls>
